name: MAKE THE BELIEF BET
title: MAKE THE BELIEF BET

match_reason: The matcher gave most weight to action avoidance in the context of relationship. Its distinct move—to state the prediction, perform a safe test, and compare outcome with forecast—supports the next need to check the facts.
unique_game_move: State the prediction, perform a safe test, and compare outcome with forecast.
trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER: Action avoidance & procrastination
SUBPATTERN: Action avoidance

PLAY TIME
about 3 minutes
goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let behaviour settle what argument cannot.

WHY THIS WORKS
The useful turn in “MAKE THE BELIEF BET” helps you test a belief through visible action. Look for it at Pay Out.

GAME MOVE
State the prediction, perform a safe test, and compare outcome with forecast.
play_the_loop:
① STATE BELIEF — State the belief as a measurable forecast.
② CHOOSE SAFE — Choose a safe, small action that could prove it wrong as well as right.
③ RECORD EXPECTED — Record the expected result before acting.
④ TEST OBSERVATION — Run the test, then compare observation with prediction.
⑤ PAY OUT — Pay out only to evidence.
win_reward:
🏆 WIN
The outcome updates confidence in the belief, even if the update is small.

✨ REWARD
UNLOCKED — State Belief reached Pay Out; the change is recognisable and repeatable.
formula_flow: State Belief → Choose Safe → Record Expected → Test Observation → Pay Out ↺ WIN
safety: PAUSE — Cancel any experiment involving danger, coercion, medical risk, or another person’s consent.

return_cue: Use “MAKE THE BELIEF BET” when action avoidance returns; begin with State Belief.
